# 存储空间 / Storage

> 设置 / Setting

按工作区查看本机文件快照占用，手动清理符合条件的会话。

Inspect local file snapshot usage by workspace and clean up eligible session histories.

## 完整功能清单 / Everything included

- **智能体可直接控制 / Direct Agent control** · 预览并清理会话文件快照
  - Preview and clean up session file snapshots
  - 说明：选择工作区和未活跃时长，核对会话及预计释放空间后确认清理。
  - Why & how: Choose workspaces and an inactivity period, review the affected sessions and estimated space, then confirm cleanup.

## 怎么用 / How to use it

1. 打开存储空间，选择工作区和清理范围。
   Open Storage and select the workspaces and inactivity period.
2. 核对预览并确认删除文件快照。
   Review the preview and confirm deletion of file snapshots.

入口 / Entry: 设置 → 设备 → 存储空间 / Settings → Device → Storage
